card.name: The word each in per-unit rules
card.fires_on: The word "each" (also "every", or "day" after "working") right after "for" or "to", where a rule is applied once per item or unit. It appears in dosing, nutrition, penalty and procedure-step instructions.

modes.label: each after for
modes.description: "each" after "for" or "to" introduces a per-unit amount or a repeated step.
modes.example: adding 10 mL of sterile water for<< each>> tablet, waiting for 5 minutes,

modes.label: per working day
modes.description: "day" ends the phrase "for each working day" in a late-penalty rule.
modes.example: may apply for each working<< day>> late up to ten working days at which

modes.label: every / increment of
modes.description: "every" or "of" starts a per-unit or per-increment statement.

card.plain: It marks the point in an instruction where something is repeated or scaled per item, as in "for each tablet" or "for each kg".
